user.title: Connect ScaleVault
user.description: Paste the API key generated in ScaleVault under Account Settings → Integrations.

data.base_url: ScaleVault URL (advanced — leave default unless testing against a dev/staging server)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and that ScaleVault is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This ScaleVault account is already configured.

init.title: ScaleVault climate telemetry
init.description: Pick which temperature/humidity sensors to forward to ScaleVault. Their state changes are batched and pushed roughly once a minute.

map.title: Map sensors to enclosures
map.description: Optional: pick which ScaleVault enclosure each sensor belongs to, so readings land there automatically instead of showing up as an unmapped device. Each field below is one of the sensors you just selected (labeled by entity ID).

log_feeding.name: Log feeding
log_feeding.description: Log a feeding in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Animal code (e.g. A-0001) or enclosure code (e.g. E-0004) — a single-animal enclosure resolves to that animal automatically. Leave blank to use the "Feeding target" select entity's current pick.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry.

log_watering.name: Log water check
log_watering.description: Log a water check in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Enclosure code (e.g. E-0004). Leave blank to use the "Enclosure target" select entity's current pick.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry.

log_cleaning.name: Log cleaning
log_cleaning.description: Log a cleaning in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Enclosure code (e.g. E-0004). Leave blank to use the "Enclosure target" select entity's current pick.
